title: Church of Saint Euphemianos, Lysi
geometryBasis: The named OSM way provides an 8.58 by 7.70 m bounding rectangle. The south entrance view and east apse view determine the main roof and wall offsets and the round apse. The two views share one documented appearance date.
sectionBasis: Exterior wall heights, the side doorway, drum and dome rise estimated from photographic proportions. Original public terrain places the doorway threshold within its local grade. Model units are metres.
limitations: The rectangle sets the overall dimensions. Offsets, curves, heights, masonry courses and individual tiles are estimated from the two June 2010 exterior photographs.
The north and west elevations are simplified continuations of the documented walls and barrel roof. The roof form and openings are an exterior interpretation.
The original terrain is preserved. Foundation embedment and threshold registration are approximate. The appearance is scoped to the 2010 photo year.
